nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _rOwn: reflected token balances per account
mapping(address=>uint256) private _tOwn: actual token balances for excluded/reward-free accounts
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allow: ERC20 allowances
mapping(address=>bool) private _excludedFee: accounts exempt from transfer fees
mapping(address=>bool) private _excluded: accounts excluded from reflection rewards
address[] private _exclude: list of reward-excluded accounts
uint256 private _tTotal: total token supply 1.1e15 * 10**18
uint256 private _rTotal: total reflected supply used as denominator for the rate
uint256 private _tFee: accumulated fees paid to holders
uint256 public _transFee: percentage fee applied to a transfer (set per transaction)
address _polyBridge: Polygon/Matic bridge address exempt from fees and rewards
address private _owner: privileged owner from Ownable, controls onlyOwner functions
constructor: mints the whole reflected supply to the deployer and pre-populates fee/reward exclusion lists
balanceOf(address): returns _tOwn for excluded accounts else reflects _rOwn via tokenReflect
transfer(address,uint256): ERC20 transfer invoking _transfer with msg.sender as sender
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): transfers and decrements allowance via _approve
approve(address,uint256): sets allowance for msg.sender via _approve
_transfer(address,address,uint256): validates inputs, decides payFee/noEthereum, and calls _tokenSend
_tokenSend(address,address,uint256,bool): sets _transFee tier from amount and dispatches to the correct reflect-transfer path
_transferNormal: reflect transfer when neither side is reward-excluded (fees taken)
_transferToExclude: transfer where the recipient is reward-excluded
_transferFromExclude: transfer where the sender is reward-excluded
_transferBothExclude: transfer where both sender and recipient are reward-excluded
delivery(uint256): burns reflected balance of the caller and adds the amount to _tFee without redistributing
excludeReward(address) onlyOwner: marks an account as reward-excluded and snapshots its token balance
includeReward(address) onlyOwner: re-includes an account into rewards and removes it from _exclude
excludeFee(address) onlyOwner: exempts an account from transfer fees
includeFee(address) onlyOwner: re-enables fees for an account
_rewardFee(uint256,uint256): reduces _rTotal by rFee and increases _tFee, redistributing value to holders
calcFee(uint256): computes amount * _transFee / 100
_values(uint256): derives rAmount, rTransAmount, rFee, tTransAmount, tFee for a transfer
_rate(): reflection rate = rSupply / tSupply
_currentSupply(): subtracts excluded balances from _rTotal/_tTotal to produce adjusted supplies
tokenReflect(uint256): converts a reflected amount back into tokens using _rate
reflectToken(uint256,bool): converts a token amount into reflected amount, optionally with fee deducted
owner(): returns the current _owner
renounceOwnership() onlyOwner: sets _owner to address(0)
transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner: replaces _owner with newOwner
msg.sender (via _msgSender()): externally controlled caller used for authorization, ownership and transfer origin
IERC20(address(this)).balanceOf(0xdEAD...) external self-call executed inside _transfer to detect non-Ethereum chain
state write of _transFee based on the untrusted transfer amount inside _tokenSend
unchecked redistribution accounting: _rTotal subtraction and _tFee addition in _rewardFee while no reentrancy guard exists
privileged write of _owner in transferOwnership/renounceOwnership guarded only by _msgSender() equality
multiple sequential _rOwn/_tOwn balance mutations based on _values output in the transfer branches

edges.reason: transfer() uses msg.sender as the debited sender, so the caller fully controls the source of funds
transferFrom() uses msg.sender to check and decrement the allowance
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner
delivery() uses msg.sender as the sender whose reflected balance is destroyed
constructor assigns _owner from _msgSender(), giving the deployer every privilege
renounceOwnership is restricted to the account equal to _msgSender()
transferOwnership is restricted to the account equal to _msgSender()
excludeReward is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares _owner to _msgSender()
includeReward is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares _owner to _msgSender()
excludeFee is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares _owner to _msgSender()
includeFee is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares _owner to _msgSender()
transfer() delegates the whole transfer to _transfer
transferFrom() delegates the transfer to _transfer before fixing the allowance
_transfer computes payFee and then calls _tokenSend
_transfer performs the IERC20(address(this)).balanceOf(...) external self-call
an external call is made before the fee and balance state updates in _tokenSend, so a re-entrant callback would observe stale accounting
_tokenSend selects _transferNormal for the standard non-excluded case
_tokenSend selects _transferToExclude when the recipient is reward-excluded
_tokenSend selects _transferFromExclude when the sender is reward-excluded
_tokenSend selects _transferBothExclude when both sides are reward-excluded
_transFee is written from the untrusted transaction amount via the tier if/else chain
calcFee multiplies the amount by the mutable _transFee state variable
_values consumes the calcFee result to derive tFee and tTransAmount
_transferNormal writes balances from the reflected amounts returned by _values
_transferToExclude writes balances from the reflected amounts returned by _values
_transferFromExclude writes balances from the reflected amounts returned by _values
_transferBothExclude writes balances from the reflected amounts returned by _values
_transferNormal forwards the fee to _rewardFee
_transferToExclude forwards the fee to _rewardFee
_transferFromExclude forwards the fee to _rewardFee
_transferBothExclude forwards the fee to _rewardFee
_rewardFee subtracts rFee from the global reflected supply _rTotal
_rewardFee adds tFee to the accumulated _tFee balance
the redistribution accounting is applied without any guard, so rate manipulation changes every holder balance
_transferNormal subtracts and adds _rOwn balances using values derived from the reflection rate
_transferNormal performs the sequential _rOwn mutations that the arithmetic risk applies to
_values calls _rate to obtain the current reflection rate
_rate derives rSupply and tSupply from _currentSupply
_currentSupply reads the _rTotal state variable
_currentSupply reads the _tTotal state variable
tokenReflect divides the reflected amount by the rate returned by _rate
reflectToken expands the token amount using _values
balanceOf reads _rOwn for non-excluded accounts
balanceOf reads _tOwn for reward-excluded accounts
balanceOf branches on the _excluded mapping
constructor hard-codes the fee-exempt charity, project and owner addresses into _excludedFee
constructor marks _polyBridge as reward-excluded
constructor mints the entire reflected supply into _rOwn of the deployer
delivery subtracts rAmount from _rTotal
delivery increases _tFee by the delivered amount
delivery subtracts the caller reflected balance in _rOwn
transferOwnership writes the privileged _owner state variable
renounceOwnership overwrites _owner with address(0)
excludeReward toggles the _excluded flag controlling reward eligibility
excludeReward pushes the account onto _exclude
includeReward clears the _excluded flag of the account
excludeFee sets the _excludedFee flag for the account
includeFee clears the _excludedFee flag for the account
_transfer consults _excludedFee[from]/[to] to decide whether fees are skipped
_transfer compares the sender with the _polyBridge exemption address
_tokenSend branches on the _excluded mapping for both sender and recipient
transferFrom decrements the _allow mapping after moving tokens
approve writes the new allowance into _allow
the ownership mutation operation directly rewrites the _owner state variable

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only meaningful as the destination argument of transfer(address,uint256)
amount is only meaningful as the value argument of transfer(address,uint256)
sender is the debited account argument of transferFrom(address,address,uint256)
recipient is the credited account argument of transferFrom(address,address,uint256)
amount is the value argument used for the allowance subtraction in transferFrom
spender is the allowance target of approve(address,uint256)
amount is the allowance value written by approve(address,uint256)
account is only used to index _rOwn/_tOwn inside balanceOf(address)
tAmount is the token amount converted by reflectToken(uint256,bool)
tAmount is the amount removed from the caller balance in delivery(uint256)
account is the target whose _excluded flag excludeReward sets
account is the target whose _excluded flag includeReward clears
account is the target whose _excludedFee flag excludeFee sets
account is the target whose _excludedFee flag includeFee clears
newOwner is only used as the replacement value for _owner in transferOwnership
_amount is the multiplicand used by calcFee to scale by _transFee
from is the source account of the internal _transfer routine
to is the destination account of the internal _transfer routine
amount is the value passed from _transfer down to _tokenSend and _values
sender selects the _excluded/_excludedFee branch inside _tokenSend
recipient selects the _excluded/_excludedFee branch inside _tokenSend
amount drives the _transFee tier selection inside _tokenSend
rAmount is the reflected amount divided by the rate in tokenReflect
payFee is a temporary decision flag local to _transfer before calling _tokenSend
noEthereum is a temporary chain-detection flag local to _transfer
rAmount is the transient reflected debit computed by _values and consumed by the transfer branch
tFee is the transient fee value computed by _values and forwarded to _rewardFee
currentRate is the transient rate snapshot taken from _rate inside tokenReflect
rSupply is the transient accumulator of excluded reflected balances in _currentSupply
tSupply is the transient accumulator of excluded token balances in _currentSupply
